text: CHECKER (nhr-evidence NE-8 NRV-1): capabilities::host_of, the host a static `@[contained(net: [...])]` pin is checked against, also ends the authority at `\`, as the WHATWG parser the HTTP client dials with does: `https://evil.example\@a.trusted.io` is now checked as evil.example (refused unless granted) instead of a.trusted.io. Hosts without a backslash are unchanged. g01 M4872
